title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE PROSECUTOR QUOTA ACT
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe the authorized number of prosecutors for each prosecutors' office pursuant to Article 2 of the Prosecutor Quota Act.

Article 2 Deleted. <Feb. 22, 2008>

Article 3 (Authorized Number)
The authorized number of prosecutors for each prosecutors' office shall be as specified in the attached Table. <Amended on Feb. 8, 2007; Feb. 22, 2008; Feb. 7, 2022; May 23, 2023>

4. One district prosecutors' office prosecutor among the authorized number for the Daegu District Prosecutors' Office;
5. Two district prosecutors' office prosecutors among the authorized number for the Busan District Prosecutors' Office;

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)

Article 2 (Amendments to Other Decrees)
(1) Part of the Organization of the Ministry of Justice and Its Affiliated Agencies shall be amended as follows:
In Article 10 (2), "chief prosecutor or senior prosecutorial officer" shall be replaced by "chief prosecutor".
Article 11 (2) shall be amended as follows:
"(2) The head of the Legal Affairs Office shall be a chief prosecutor, and each division director, the Legal Affairs Counselor, Litigation Counselor, and International Legal Affairs Counselor shall each be a prosecutor."
In Article 12 (2), "chief prosecutor or senior prosecutorial officer" shall be replaced by "chief prosecutor", and "senior prosecutorial officer or prosecutorial officer" shall be replaced by "prosecutor".
In Article 13 (2), "chief prosecutor or senior prosecutorial officer" shall be replaced by "chief prosecutor", and "senior prosecutorial officer or prosecutorial officer" shall be replaced by "prosecutor".
In Article 14 (2), "chief prosecutor or senior prosecutorial officer" shall be replaced by "chief prosecutor".
In Article 20 (2), "senior prosecutorial officer" shall be replaced by "prosecutor".
In Article 22 (2), "chief prosecutor or senior prosecutorial officer" shall be replaced by "chief prosecutor", and "senior prosecutorial officer or prosecutorial officer" shall be replaced by "prosecutor"; and in paragraph (5) of that Article, "senior prosecutorial officer or prosecutorial officer" shall be replaced by "prosecutor".
In attached Table 1, "senior prosecutorial officers: 3", "senior prosecutorial officers or prosecutorial officers: 14", and "prosecutorial officers: 32" shall each be deleted, and "prosecutors: 49" shall be newly inserted in the same column.
In attached Table 2, "senior prosecutorial officers: 2" and "senior prosecutorial officers or prosecutorial officers: 3" shall each be deleted, and "prosecutors: 5" shall be newly inserted in the same column.
(2) Part of the Regulations on Payment of Honorary Retirement Allowances to State Public Officials shall be amended as follows:
In Article 2, "prosecutors of the rank of senior prosecutorial officer or below" shall be replaced by "prosecutors".
(3) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Remuneration of Prosecutors shall be amended as follows:
In Article 11, "senior prosecutorial officer" shall be replaced by "prosecutor with at least 10 years of legal experience", and "prosecutorial officer" shall be replaced by "prosecutor with less than 10 years of legal experience"; and paragraph (2) shall be newly inserted in that Article as follows:
"(2) The term 'legal experience' in paragraph (1) means experience including periods aggregated for determination of the salary step upon appointment as a prosecutor pursuant to Article 3 (2) and periods recognized for salary-step advancement pursuant to paragraphs (3) and (4) of that Article."
